scope: sensitive-data exposure and upload UX boundaries

inspection.unsafe_html_search: No bypassSecurityTrust or innerHTML code-search hit found in the targeted repository scan.

findings.finding: Frontend hosting configuration exposed only Permissions-Policy and lacked explicit clickjacking, MIME-sniffing, referrer, HSTS and minimal CSP frame/base/object protections.
findings.resolution: Added CSP frame-ancestors/base-uri/object-src, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options and Referrer-Policy while preserving the existing camera permission required by product UX.

findings.finding: Bearer token persists in localStorage, so any future successful XSS could access the token.
findings.mitigation: No unsafe HTML bypass/sink was found in the targeted scan; Angular escaping remains in force; route/tenant/permission guards fail closed; backend remains the authorization authority. Migrating to HttpOnly-cookie authentication would be a cross-contract redesign and is not required to close current P0/P1.
